value.body: A graphic designer creates illustrations, layouts, logos and other visual material for print and digital use. Advertising and design agencies, publishers, media houses and in-house brand teams hire designers, and many work freelance. A typical day is working on briefs, producing drafts and revising them on feedback.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BFA (Applied Art) or B.Des, plus a portfolio

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Hiring is mostly portfolio-based. Freshers usually start as junior designers or interns at an agency, studio or in-house team, or take freelance projects to build a body of work.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Working to a brief and taking feedback

value.title: At a glance
items: A strong portfolio often matters more than the degree.
Typical path: junior designer, designer, senior designer, art director.
Some move into UI/UX or motion design with extra skills.
